title: Open the registration page from the login page
preconditions: Browser is logged out and the home page is open at http://localhost:3000.
step: Open the Account menu in the top bar and choose «Login».
expected: The login page should open.

step: Click «Not yet a customer?».
expected: The registration page «User Registration» should open with the fields «Email», «Password», «Repeat Password», «Security Question» and «Answer».

title: Register with valid data
preconditions: Registration page is open. Use a new email, for example reconqa-user-001@example.test (it is reused in TC-REG-013).
step: Enter the new email in «Email». Enter Reconqa#2026 in «Password» and in «Repeat Password».
expected: No error message should be shown under the three fields.

step: Choose «Name of your favorite pet?» in «Security Question» and enter Rex in «Answer».
expected: The «Register» button should be enabled.

step: Click «Register».
expected: The login page should open. A toast «Registration completed successfully. You can now log in.» should be shown.

title: After registration the user is not logged in automatically
preconditions: Registration page is open. Use a new email, for example reconqa-user-002@example.test.
step: Fill all fields with valid data and click «Register».
expected: The login page should open, not the product list.

step: Open the Account menu in the top bar.
expected: The menu should offer «Login», which shows the user is still logged out.

title: Required text fields show an error when left empty
preconditions: Registration page is open and all fields are empty.
step: Click into «Email», then click outside it.
expected: «Please provide an email address.» should be shown under the field.

step: Click into «Password», then click outside it.
expected: «Please provide a password.» should be shown under the field.

step: Click into «Repeat Password», then click outside it.
expected: «Please repeat your password.» should be shown under the field.

step: Click into «Answer», then click outside it.
expected: «Please provide an answer to your security question.» should be shown under the field.

title: Security question is required
preconditions: Registration page is open and all fields are empty.
step: Open the «Security Question» dropdown, close it without choosing an option, then click outside it.
expected: «Please select a security question.» should be shown under the dropdown.

title: Register button is disabled until the form is valid
preconditions: Registration page is open and all fields are empty.
step: Look at the «Register» button.
expected: The button should be disabled.

step: Fill every field except «Answer» with valid data.
expected: The button should stay disabled.

step: Enter any text in «Answer».
expected: The button should be enabled.

title: Invalid email format is rejected
step: Enter reconqa-bad-email in «Email», then click outside the field.
expected: «Email address is not valid.» should be shown under the field.

step: Replace it with reconqa-user-003@example.test and click outside the field.
expected: The error should disappear.

title: Password one character below the minimum
step: Enter Ab1! (4 characters) in «Password», then click outside the field.
expected: «Password must be 5-40 characters long.» should be shown under the field.

step: Add one character so the password is 5 characters long (Ab1!x).
expected: The error should disappear.

title: Password of 7 characters is accepted by the app
preconditions: Registration page is open. The ticket asks for at least 8 characters; the app hint says 5-40, so this case checks the app's behaviour.
step: Fill «Email», «Security Question» and «Answer» with valid data. Enter Ab1!xyz (7 characters) in «Password» and «Repeat Password».
expected: No error should be shown under «Password».

step: Look at the «Register» button.
expected: The button should be enabled.

title: Password at the maximum length
step: Enter a password of exactly 40 characters (Ab1! followed by 36 letters x) in «Password» and click outside the field.
expected: No error should be shown under «Password».
source: atlas login-and-registration.md (missing in ticket, mismatch row 5)

step: Clear the field and type 41 letters a.
expected: The field should hold at most 40 characters. The atlas shows the counter as «40/20» here (likely defect, see mismatch row 6).

title: Repeated password must match
step: Enter Reconqa#2026 in «Password» and Reconqa#2027 in «Repeat Password», then click outside the field.
expected: «Passwords do not match» should be shown under «Repeat Password».

step: Fix «Repeat Password» so it equals «Password».
expected: The error should disappear.

title: Password advice can be shown
step: Turn on «Show password advice».
expected: A strength bar and a checklist should appear.

step: Read the checklist.
expected: It should list «contains at least one lower character», «contains at least one upper character», «contains at least one digit», «contains at least one special character» and «contains at least 8 characters».

step: Turn the switch off.
expected: The strength bar and checklist should disappear.

title: Duplicate email is rejected
preconditions: Registration page is open. An account already exists for reconqa-user-001@example.test (created in TC-REG-002).
step: Enter reconqa-user-001@example.test in «Email» and valid data in all other fields.
expected: The «Register» button should be enabled.

step: Click «Register».
expected: An alert banner «Email must be unique» should be shown under the «User Registration» heading.

step: Check the page.
expected: The user should stay on the registration page. The ticket text "This email is already registered." should not be expected.

title: Security question warning and options
step: Look at the «Security Question» field.
expected: The hint «This cannot be changed later!» should be shown.

step: Open the dropdown and count the options.
expected: There should be 14 options. The first should be «Your eldest siblings middle name?» and the last «What's your favorite place to go hiking?».
